name: Apologizing
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on apologizing — practice these key phrases out loud:
I didn't mean for that to happen — my mistake.
Thanks for your patience, and sorry for the delay.
I should have let you know sooner. I apologize.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
